title: Kooky Savory Slovakian Beef Bowl
description: A hearty Slovakian dish featuring beef stock cubes and melted cheese, served in a stone bowl, perfect for a midnight craving. This dish combines Mediterranean flavors with traditional Slovakian ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the beef stock cubes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to the stone bowl and top with crumbled feta cheese.
Bake the mixture in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the bowl from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the Kooky Savory Slovakian Beef Bowl hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
